spec_hint: Paste or open a text; device motion shifts the text opposite to phone shake so lines stay steady while walking; font size control.
Shows one kind compliment per day from a built-in list; add your own; same compliment all day, new one tomorrow.
List pantry items with quantity and minimum; tap to use one; items below minimum gather on a restock list to copy or print.
Jot quick thoughts; each fades over a few days unless you pin it, act on it, or turn it into a task; faded ones vanish.
Set wake time; screen goes full-screen and slowly brightens from black to warm white over 30 minutes, then plays a soft chime.
Save each friend's usual custom order by name and place; pick who's coming to get one combined order list to read out.
Paste URLs; removes utm, fbclid, gclid and other tracking parameters, keeps essential ones; shows cleaned link with copy button.
Random story prompt plus constraint and word goal; write in the box; word counter fills a progress bar, streaks and levels saved locally.
Add grooming tasks (haircut, nails, brows) with repeat interval; shows what's due or overdue; tap done to reset the clock.
Log words written per day per project; daily goal, streak, and a step-counter-style chart of the last weeks.
Type scrambled letters; draggable tiles to rearrange and shuffle, try a guess, get letter-count checks; never reveals the answer.
Log applications: company, role, date, stage, cover letter version used; board by stage; follow-up dates; export CSV.
List your activities and weekly targets; log what you did; suggests the activity most behind its weekly target.
Paste text; swaps gendered words (he/she, him/her, king/queen, man/woman) preserving case; shows result to copy.
Notes fall down four lanes to a synthesized beat; tap or slice lanes on time; score, combo, three difficulty levels.
Enter a hex color and liquid volume; outputs drops of red, yellow, blue, black food coloring with a preview swatch.
Shows a randomly generated license plate in a chosen country style, changing every minute, full-screen.
Add rooms, then items with photo, value and purchase date; totals per room; print or export a list for insurance.
Add things you're looking forward to with dates; shows them in date order with days left; past ones fade away.
Add trials with start date, length and price; list sorted by days left with warning colors; export dates as an .ics file.
Type player names, pick number of teams; shuffles into balanced teams with colors; reshuffle button.
Enter your street's sweeping rule (e.g. 2nd Tuesday 8-10am); shows next dates and countdown; download reminders as .ics.
List clothes and bags; assign each item to a bag by tapping; per-bag lists, counts and a checklist to tick while packing.
Each day record three things you're grateful for, typed or a short voice note; browse past days; saved on device.
Hum into the mic; detects pitch, lists the note sequence, shows guitar and bass fret positions and a likely key.
Guided form for your funeral wishes: music, readings, burial or cremation, who to tell; saved locally, printable summary.
Kid picks tables; quick questions with big buttons; tracks which facts are mastered and repeats the missed ones.
Set tonight's budget; tap to add each drink or ticket; big meter shows what's left and warns as you near the limit.
Drop meme images in; tag them, search by tag, copy or download; stored in the browser on your device.
A potted plant grows over real days; water, move to light, prune; neglect wilts it; state saved locally.
One huge button that plays a synthesized fanfare with confetti when you smash it; a few fanfare styles.
A short text-free adventure narrated by speech synthesis with sound effects; choose with arrow keys or taps; no visuals needed.
Draw a room, place TV, speakers, consoles and outlets; connect them with labeled cables; lists cable lengths; save and print.
Load a photo; add a translucent caption bar you drag up and down; export the captioned image.
Ten big digits on screen; pressing keys 0-9 toggles each on or off with a click sound; shows the lit set.
Outline of a hockey glove split into panels; pick a color for each panel; export PNG of your design.
Drop code files; renames .js and other blocked extensions to .txt, builds a zip in-browser plus a rename-back note; download.
A long checklist of geeky things you've done, updated for the 2020s; tick boxes; shows your geek percentage and rank.
Enter today's screen time minutes; converts to push-ups, pages to read and minutes walked by ratios you set; tick them off.
Set wake and sleep times; shows hours and minutes of waking time left today as a draining bar.
Diary that looks like a messenger thread with yourself; type entries as bubbles with timestamps, day separators, search; saved locally.
Add tasks with effort and time estimates; sort by quick wins, lowest effort or longest; check off; saved locally.
Touch game: your fingertip is the character; drag to dodge falling obstacles and collect dots; lifting your finger ends the run.
Weekly chore chart per child; each chore's reward shrinks the more times it's been paid, tallies earnings; printable.
Add tasks and rate how ashamed you'd feel if undone; list sorts by shame times days left; check off; saved locally.
Enter your clothes by type, color and season; generates outfit combinations that match; mark favorites and worn dates.
List friends with how often you want to talk; log each catch-up; shows who you're overdue to contact first.
Register keys by number and door; record who borrowed each and when; returns, overdue list, history; export CSV.
Add food with expiry date; list sorted by days left, red when close; tap eaten or tossed to track waste.
A pixel pet that gets hungry, bored and tired in real time; feed, play, put to sleep; state saved locally.
Type options or pick a preset (what to eat, which movie); spinning wheel picks one; saved lists for repeat decisions.
Type labels and values; draws a pie chart styled as a shaded beach ball with stripes; export PNG.
Load one concert audio file and paste the setlist; finds gaps between songs, lets you adjust cuts, exports each song as WAV.
Type a censored word like f*** or s**t; lists matching swear words from a built-in list.
Paste text; expands SMS shorthand (brb, idk, l8r) to full words, or compresses full text into shorthand.
Pick an event date; shows a dramatic dark full-screen countdown 'Dawn of the first day — 72 hours remain' style.
Table of devices: name, IP, MAC, location, notes; flags duplicate IPs, shows free addresses in the subnet; export CSV.
Log trips biked instead of driven; with car mpg and fuel price, totals money and fuel saved over time.
Procedurally generated orchestra tuning-up sound with Web Audio; endless, never repeating; volume and sleep timer.
Type a phone number with country code and optional message; builds a WhatsApp click-to-chat link to open or copy.
Paste or open book text; type it paragraph by paragraph with mistakes highlighted; WPM and accuracy per paragraph; resume where you stopped.
Stopwatch for work; when you stop, a break timer counts down equal to the time worked (or a ratio); daily totals.
Pick the book you're reading; quick-entry box saves a thought with page number; browse thoughts per book; export text.
Shows current Swatch Internet Time and Vana'diel time side by side; convert any date or .beat value both ways.
